name: The SCP Elevator (v. 2.4)
desc:
🛑 Welcome to The SCP Elevator!
Enter the terrifying SCP Elevator where each floor brings you closer to monsters, mystery, and horror.
Will you survive the horrifying SCPs lurking in every corner?

Multiplayer mode – team up with friends and survive together! 👥
Escape from famous SCPs like SCP-173, SCP-096, SCP-682, and more! 🧟‍♂️
🔥 New Update! More SCPs added! Can you survive them all? 😱

👍 Like the game and follow for new updates!
🔎 Tags: #SCP #Horror #Survival #Escape #Elevator #Monsters #SCP #SCP173 #SCP096 #SCP682 #SCP106 #SCP087


This game is based on the SCP universe, a collaborative writing project of the SCP Foundation.
This is an unofficial, fan-made project not affiliated with the SCP Foundation.
